MATHEMATICS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #9
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. In the number 3545, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 400
   B. 40
   C. 4
   D. 10

2. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 8 cm and 15 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 17
   B. 23
   C. 19
   D. 7

3. In the number 3145, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 400
   B. 10
   C. 4
   D. 40

4. Solve for x: x + 7 = 17. (1 mark)
   A. 17
   B. 11
   C. 10
   D. 7

5. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 5
   B. 10
   C. 25
   D. 26

6. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 18
   B. 36
   C. 81
   D. 90

7. What is 4 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 24
   C. 2
   D. 10

8. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 82
   B. 9
   C. 81
   D. 18

9. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 144
   B. 48
   C. 24
   D. 156

10. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 169
   B. 26
   C. 170
   D. 13

11. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 42
   B. 12
   C. 36
   D. 24

12. What is 4 × 9? (1 mark)
   A. 13
   B. 5
   C. 37
   D. 36

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 80 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

14. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 85 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

15. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 90 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

16. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 95 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
